<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/commerce.ts -->
<!--
  A section with a heading and the products as cards in a grid, as a list of horizontal cards, or as a rail that
  scrolls sideways. Axes: layout (grid, list, rail), columns, ratio, rating, action, tone, density.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Product, ProductLabels } from "./product-card.types";

  export type ProductGridProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    products: Product[];
    labels: ProductLabels;
    badges: Record<string, string>;
    layout?: "grid" | "list" | "rail";
    cols?: "1-2" | "1-3" | "1-4";
    ratio?: "4/3" | "1/1" | "3/4";
    rating?: "show" | "hide";
    action?: "button" | "none";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    density?: "roomy" | "default" | "compact";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
    onadd?: (id: string) => void;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../primitives/box/box.svelte";
  import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.svelte";
  import ProductCard from "../blocks/product-card.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    products,
    labels,
    badges,
    layout = "grid",
    cols = "1-3",
    ratio = "4/3",
    rating = "show",
    action = "button",
    tone = "default",
    density = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
    onadd,
  }: ProductGridProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame id={id} title={title} tone={tone} density={density} landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}>
  {#if ((layout as string) === "rail")}
    <Box class="flex snap-x gap-4 overflow-x-auto pb-4" data-testid="items">
      {#each products as p (p.id)}
        <Box class="w-64 shrink-0 snap-start">
          <ProductCard
            product={p}
            labels={labels}
            badges={badges}
            layout={(((layout as string) === "list") ? "horizontal" : "vertical")}
            ratio={ratio}
            rating={rating}
            action={action}
            density={(((density as string) === "compact") ? "compact" : "default")}
            onadd={() => onadd?.(p.id)}
          />
        </Box>
      {/each}
    </Box>
  {:else}
    <Grid cols={(((layout as string) === "list") ? "1" : cols)} class="gap-4" data-testid="items">
      {#each products as p (p.id)}
        <ProductCard
          product={p}
          labels={labels}
          badges={badges}
          layout={(((layout as string) === "list") ? "horizontal" : "vertical")}
          ratio={ratio}
          rating={rating}
          action={action}
          density={(((density as string) === "compact") ? "compact" : "default")}
          onadd={() => onadd?.(p.id)}
        />
      {/each}
    </Grid>
  {/if}
</SectionFrame>
